text:
maya: Quick follow-up from the token-validation postmortem — thanks everyone for the quick responses last night. I want to lock owners/timelines and a short recurring check so this doesn't drift.
rahul: ack. i'll own the immediate validation fixes and the e2e test update. creating a jira: INF-4721, target: Tue EOD for patch + PR. @maya can you add the test vectors?
maya: will drop the vectors into the jira by EOD today. also adding the failing log samples and a minimal repro snippet.
sara: for audit-logging, i'll update the retention and pipeline alert rules so we keep the raw token-validation traces for 30d. PR planned for Wed. ping me if you need the log query: ```index=auth_logs status=FAIL token_validator=* | stats count by user,endpoint``` 
john: secrets rotation note — after the root cause we need a scoped rotation for service accounts that read token keys. i'll coordinate with infra to schedule a rotation window next week. created RFC in docs: /docs/rfcs/token-hygiene-2026.md
maya: owners summary -> rahul (validation patch + tests, INF-4721), sara (audit log retention + alert, PR/alert runbook), john (secrets rotation plan + runbook). Ops check-in: weekly on Thursdays 10am for 4 weeks to confirm progress. @ops-bot can you create a recurring event?
ops-bot: Created recurring incident follow-up: channel #incidents, every Thu 10:00, 4 occurrences. Reminder DM to participants 30m before.
rahul: quick Q — do we want a canary release for the validation change? I'd prefer a small traffic slice first. propose 10% for 24h, then ramp.
maya: yes, do canary 10% for 24h. if no regressions, auto-ramp to 100%. add healthchecks: 5xx spike and token-fail-rate metrics.
sara: adding the healthchecks to the alerting playbook. putting the runbook fragment in the PR description.
john: i'll also add a KMS key policy check to ensure rotation doesn't break reads. will test in staging and post results in INF-4721.
maya: thanks. action items recap in INF-4721; i'll close the loop after the canary. if anyone hits blockers ping #eng-oncall and @maya directly. :thumbsup:
